create_dset: create an IndexableVideoDataset from a list of Video objects and a FeatureExtractConfig with clip sampling and transforms
create_data_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from a dataset and FeatureExtractConfig with configurable batch size and workers
create_data_loader_or_dset: create a DataLoader or raw dataset from a list of Video objects and a FeatureExtractConfig in one call
EncodedVideoCached_get_clip: extract a video clip as a tensor from a cached EncodedVideo between two timestamps with a given frame window size
IndexableVideoDataset_getitem: retrieve a single video clip sample with metadata and optional audio from an IndexableVideoDataset by index
